settings.question: My child is glued to screens. Will this even work?
settings.answer: That's exactly who neOwn is for. Consistent access to physical books, chosen by the child themselves using our app, is what graduallyshifts the balance away from screens. Giving kids agency over their book picks is key.

settings.question: Can I choose books/toys or will you choose?
settings.answer: You can choose your own books/toys from the neOwn app catalogExpert recommendations available if needed

settings.question: How does the book selection work?
settings.answer: Once you have subscribed, you can download our app📲 from which you can select the books 📚 You can select any books of your choice, and in case you are not sure what to pick we have a book expert in-house who can help you out if needed 💖

settings.question: How will pick-up & drop happen?
settings.answer: Select your next set of items on appTeam will confirm your selectionWe will schedule next delivery & pickup

settings.question: What happens at the end of my plan?
settings.answer: We'll remind you 7 days before your plan ends with a special renewal offer. You can renew, upgrade, pause, or stop — zero pressure. Yourreading history and wishlist stay saved in the app either way.

settings.question: Damage policy?
settings.answer:
Minor damage: No charge
Major damage OR lost books/ toys: Pay 40% of book/ toy’s MRP. You can keep the item forever!

settings.question: Are the books clean and hygienic?
settings.answer:
Our process to ensure the books are hygenic and in good condition: 

- We do a thorough check of all books twice - once after they have come back from customers and the second time before they are going to another customer 

- We also clean board books to ensure they are 100% sanitary 

- If any books are of bad quality we don't circulate them among customers anymore

settings.question: What if my child doesn't read the books?
settings.answer: Most kids start slow — that's perfectly normal. The physical presence of books at home is what starts the habit. New books every month keep curiosity alive. 85% of 3-month subscribers become consistent readers by the end of their plan.
